paragraphs: Primary Gouge stores most study activity locally on your device. That includes flashcard progress, quiz history, recent study activity, pinned focus topics, and reminder preferences.
sections.title: What the App Stores Locally

paragraphs: A Primary Gouge account is required to use the app. Account profile data can include your display name, email, selected squadron, selected syllabus, active sessions, and assigned permissions.
sections.title: Account Data

paragraphs: When you submit instructor reviews, instructor review reports, feedback, feature requests, support requests, or incorrect gouge reports, the app sends that submission data with your signed-in account.
sections.title: What the App Sends

paragraphs: Primary Gouge uses Supabase for account authentication and Premium entitlement records, Cloudflare for instructor reviews and community submissions, and Cloudflare R2 for video delivery.

When you purchase Premium, Apple processes the payment. Primary Gouge receives Apple-signed transaction identifiers, product and subscription status, expiration information, and an account-linking token. Primary Gouge does not receive your full payment-card details.
sections.title: Services and Subscriptions

paragraphs: Local study data is used on the device until you clear it through the app's account or device lifecycle. Submitted reviews, reports, and community requests are retained in the app's local submission history while they are queued or available for status tracking, and account deletion requests removal of account-associated cloud records.
sections.title: How Long Is Data Kept?

paragraphs: Notification permission is used for the daily study reminder.
sections.title: Notifications

paragraphs: You can sign out or delete your account from More > Profile. Account deletion removes the cloud account, sessions, profile, account roles, Premium entitlement link, and account-associated submitted reviews, reports, and community submissions. The app also clears the local account session and local study progress caches after deletion.

Deleting your Primary Gouge account does not cancel an App Store subscription. Cancel or manage the subscription through your Apple Account before deleting the app account if you do not want it to renew.
sections.title: Account Deletion

pages.title: Privacy

paragraphs: Primary Gouge is a study utility. It is not an official training publication, not a substitute for governing source material, and not a guarantee that any gouge or user submission is complete or current.
sections.title: Use of the App

paragraphs: You are responsible for checking official pubs, squadron guidance, and instructor direction before relying on study content or community-submitted gouge.
sections.title: Accuracy and Responsibility

paragraphs: If you submit instructor reviews, reports, feedback, feature requests, support requests, or incorrect gouge reports, you are responsible for providing truthful, non-abusive, non-sensitive content. Submissions may be moderated and may be rejected or dismissed.
sections.title: Submission Standards

paragraphs: Do not submit passwords, payment information, classified information, personal data about another person, or anything you are not authorized to share. Report incorrect study content with enough context for a moderator to identify the event, reference, or section.
sections.title: Information You Submit

paragraphs: Access requires a signed-in account. The app supports Sign in with Apple and verified email sign-in.
sections.title: Account Access

paragraphs: Premium Monthly is an automatically renewing subscription purchased through Apple. The displayed App Store price and introductory-offer eligibility control what you are charged. Payment is charged to your Apple Account, and the subscription renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

You can restore purchases or open Apple subscription management from the Premium screen. Premium access may continue during an Apple billing grace period and ends after expiration, revocation, or an unsuccessful billing-retry period.

Home, the NATOPS Question of the Day, the combined EPs / Limits / N/W/C flashcards, instructor gouge, Contacts ground school, FAM2101, and FAM2102 remain available without Premium. Premium unlocks the rest of the event pipeline and advanced study library.
